}}'''Capollo Montelli''' is a quest-exclusive NPC. 

==Profile==
As the son of [[Francesco Montelli]], he was to be the next head of the [[Montelli Family]], until {{Quest|If On a Rainy Night a Family}}, when he was caught betraying the family's ideals and conspiring with the [[Order of the Deep]] in an attempt to strengthen the family against the [[Fisalia Family]], even going so far as killing a member of the family named [[Benett]]. He was ousted and to be punished for his actions.
